name: 🍠 Sheet Pan Chicken, Sweet Potato & Broccoli
what: Chicken, sweet potatoes and broccoli roasted on hot pans until crispy at the edges.

core.name: Chicken breasts
core.out: chicken thighs (5 more minutes) or sausage

core.name: Broccoli
core.out: bagged florets, green beans or any veggie

extras: smoked paprika, garlic, lemon, parmesan, a drizzle of honey

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 425°F with two sheet pans inside.
Toss the sweet potato cubes with oil, salt and paprika. Roast on one pan first.
Toss bite-size chicken with oil and seasoning, broccoli with oil and salt.
Chicken goes next to the potatoes, broccoli on the second pan. Roast.
Squeeze lemon over everything, parmesan on top. Pack a lunch box first.

key: Hot pans and space between pieces. Crowded food steams instead of browning.
done: Chicken is white inside (165°F) and the broccoli edges are dark.
plan_b: Short on time? Skip the potatoes and serve the chicken and broccoli with rice.
